I hit an environment reset while completing the final QA: the IVX Expo source tree and APK build output are no longer available in this workspace, so I cannot truthfully claim the new fix was deployed or provide a verified new APK.

What I did verify before that interruption:
- Production API is currently healthy on commit `362e7f5e4699ff8c013367901909f27a33857fa5`.
- The root cause was identified: the execution console polled owner-only job endpoints without a bearer token, causing status updates to stop.
- The intended repair uses the active owner session for polling and turns polling timeouts into an explicit blocked result rather than an endless “working” state.
- Expo TypeScript passed and the targeted IVX owner-AI tests passed (119/119) before the workspace became unavailable.

Please restore/reopen the IVX Holdings workspace, and I’ll immediately finish the release build, deploy verification, live QA evidence, and new APK download.
